svg.text: ExpressRoute Standard Gateway Datapath vs. FastPath Bypass
Hard ceiling on ingress Gbps, PPS & active flows
Drops fragmented IP packets; BGP AS 65515
Asymmetric Behavior & Stateful Private Endpoint Caveat:
VM ingress traverses ER Gateway (SKU cap applies); VM return egress goes straight from vSwitch to MSEE.
Exception: Private Endpoint flows use ER Gateway BOTH ways (~50% cap hit; tune 15-30s TCP timeout).
ErGw3AZ | ErGwScale (>=10 SU) | UltraPerf | vWAN (>=5 SU)
Exchanges BGP routes only; bypassed by FastPath data
Receives fallback traffic when FIB full or unsupported
No PL data fee on FP
Regional Peered Spoke VNet (ER Direct Only)
FastPath Architecture Rules (Verify Direct vs. Provider):
ER Direct supports VNet Peering, GatewaySubnet UDRs, IPv6, vWAN (>=5 SU) & Limited-GA Private Link.
Alert on FastPathRoutesCount (75-80% of 100k/200k/25k) so overflow never saturates ER Gateway capacity.
